mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the largest component of the country's balance of payments (BOP)."
The balance of trade is the largest component of the country's balance of payments (BOP).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement that keeps track of all economic transactions done by the country with the remaining world."
Balance of Payment is a statement that keeps track of all economic transactions done by the country with the remaining world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an economic theory and was propounded by Paul A."
Factor price equalization is an economic theory and was propounded by Paul A.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a problem to the end country because it kills infant industry and reduce the country's level of international competitiveness."
Dumping is a problem to the end country because it kills infant industry and reduce the country's level of international competitiveness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a measure used by governments for specific political or health circumstances."
Embargoes are a measure used by governments for specific political or health circumstances.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key to economic development."
Advancement of technology is the key to economic development.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the sale of goods in small quantities to consumers."
Retail trade is concerned with the sale of goods in small quantities to consumers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an abundant factor of production and capital is a scarce factor."
Labour is an abundant factor of production and capital is a scarce factor.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one in which a monopolist firms sells its commodity at a very low price or at a loss in the foreign market in order to drive out some competitors."
The predatory dumping is the one in which a monopolist firms sells its commodity at a very low price or at a loss in the foreign market in order to drive out some competitors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relative importance of one factor versus others in production in an industry, usually compared across industries."
Factor intensity reversal is the relative importance of one factor versus others in production in an industry, usually compared across industries.
